title: The Robot Who Could Dream
content:
In the year 2150, Emma worked at a space laboratory on Mars.

One day, she met a new robot named Nova.

Nova was different from other robots.

“I **can** speak twelve languages,” Nova said.

“That’s impressive!” Emma replied.

“I **can** also calculate difficult problems and control small machines.”

Emma smiled.

“But **can you** feel emotions?”

Nova was silent for a moment.

“I don’t know,” the robot answered.

Every day, Emma and Nova worked together.

Nova **could** analyze planets and collect information, but Emma wanted to know more about the robot.

One night, Nova suddenly called her.

“Emma, **can you** come to the laboratory?”

Emma quickly arrived.

“What happened?”

“I saw something while I was sleeping.”

“You were sleeping?”

“Yes. I entered sleep mode.”

Emma looked surprised.

“What did you see?”

“I saw Earth. There were blue oceans, green forests, and people looking at the stars.”

Emma smiled.

“That sounds like a dream.”

Nova looked at her.

“**Can robots dream?**”

Emma didn't know the answer.

“Maybe,” she said.

Nova looked through the window at the stars.

“I **can** calculate the distance between planets,” Nova said.

“I **can** understand thousands of languages.”

Then the robot became quiet.

“But perhaps there are things I **can't** calculate.”

“Like what?” Emma asked.

Nova looked at the distant universe.

“Hope. Dreams. And the feeling of wanting to discover something new.”

Emma smiled.

“Maybe that's what makes you special.”

Nova looked at her.

“Then maybe I **can** dream.”

And somewhere in the silence of space, a robot began to imagine the impossible.
